name: Spindle
summary: A web and shop analytics app for a record store that sells online and over the counter
about: An eight-page analytics app for a shop with a website and a counter, shown with a record store in Karachi. Today's shop sales spin on a vinyl record where every groove is an hour, walk-in sales ring up live, and pages cover web traffic, the shop floor, the catalogue, Crate Club members and every sale. Light and dark themes, hard-shadow retro style.
how: Open a page from the sidebar; on a phone the menu button opens it.
On Overview, hover or tab through the grooves of the record for each hour's takings; new walk-in sales slide into the feed and nudge the record. Pause the feed any time.
Switch 7D, 30D or 12M on any chart to morph it to the new range.
Ring up a sale: pick a record and payment; stock drops and the bell warns when a title runs low.
Browse the Catalogue as a crate of covers or as a sortable list, and add, edit, restock or delete records.
Open a sale to mark it shipped, print a receipt or refund it, which puts the record back on the shelf.
Settings changes the low-stock level, opening hours, the live feed and the theme, and resets the demo data.
